component.name: VoxaTest
component.summary: Run end-to-end voice tests against Voxa

description.p: VoxaTest speaks test prompts, records Voxa's replies, transcribes them locally, grades the results with a local model, and writes reproducible reports.

VoxaTest now runs as its own desktop application beside Voxa, streaming progress live and writing JSON, text and a Git-friendly failure report that is updated after every case. Spoken replies are captured in full before the next prompt, a failing case never stops the run, and the run can be stopped at any time without losing results, so runs of hundreds of tests work unattended.
